primary_text: Ramadan asks everything of you. Your lips — drained by fasting and rinsed clean by every wudu — crack before Asr and you've got nothing left you trust to use. Tayyib Halal Tallow Lip Balm seals deep overnight and absorbs fast enough to wear through the day. Halal-certified. Safe to ingest. No guilt, no wiping it off.
headline: No water for 16 hours. Wudu five times. Your lips need this.
